besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses ('Suid-Afrika het ...' and 'ons kakao kom ...').
besluite.rede: Both clauses have their own subject and verb, so the comma is required, and the protected wording 'Suid-Afrika het nie sulke plekke nie' stays intact.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'word hulle meer werd' has its own subject and verb, so the house comma rule applies, and the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: Singular 'dop' with the plural owner 'hul' (many beans) reads stiffly.
besluite.rede: Afrikaans normally uses the plural for a countable thing each of several owners has, so 'hul harde doppe' is more natural and says the same thing.

besluite.fout: 'verkoop sy bone voor die meeste waarde' first reads as a prepositional phrase, so the reader stumbles until 'bygevoeg is'.
besluite.rede: 'voordat ... bygevoeg word' removes the garden path while keeping the same sequence and the qualifier 'die meeste'.

besluite.fout: 'Gisting is wanneer ...' copies the English 'X is when' definition pattern.
besluite.rede: The fault is real, but this is a glossary definition beyond a plain spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may reword it, for every lesson at once.
